Tata Elxsi Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tata Elxsi Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 07, 2026, regarding the opening of a Special Window for Transfer and Dematerialization of Physical Securities. The window is open from November 05, 2026, to November 04, 2027. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is also available on the company website at www.tataelxsi.com. The notice applies to shares issued on or after November 01, 2019. Physical securities must be submitted to the designated agency, MUFG Bank, Ltd., in Mumbai.
